Sales Training & Coaching – Train teams on consultative selling, objection handling, and increasing closing rates.

Cargo AI (Sales Copilot) – Orchestrate all go-to-market operations in one hub.

AI Growth Plan Creator – Auto-build personalized step-by-step growth blueprints.

AI Offer Creator – Craft high-converting offers, funnels, and upsell flows.

AI Pricing Calculator – Data-driven pricing to maximize margins & conversions.

Continuity & Membership Models – Recurring revenue structures (VIP Glow Club, Hormone/Peptide packages, etc.).

Packaging & Bundling – Strategic treatment + product bundles that drive higher lifetime value.

Arcads / MakeUGC / ReelFarm – AI-generated UGC-style video ads for Meta, TikTok, and Reels.

OpusClip & Descript – Convert long-form videos (podcasts, webinars, trainings) into viral short-form content.

Captions.ai & Bluecast – Auto-subtitles, LinkedIn content, and visibility tools.

EverArt / Playground AI / Recraft AI – Custom AI-powered design for branding, mockups, and ads.

Beatoven.ai – Royalty-free custom music for video ads & wellness content.

5. Client Retention & Experience

Blaise AI – AI-powered success agent for 24/7 education & client communication.

Intercom AI & Proxy AI – AI customer service that improves satisfaction while lowering costs.

Fireflies.ai / Fathom – Auto-record and summarize consults or team meetings.

NotebookLM & Supermemory – “Second brain” for staff training, protocols, and client FAQs.

Custom Membership Portals – Easy-to-use digital hubs for clients (education, scheduling, payments).

6. Advanced Enablement & Add-Ons

Consulting Sprints – Focused projects (e.g., HRT launch, AgeJET campaign, Private-Equity Exit Prep).

Done-for-You Creative – AI-generated video ads, sales decks, or branded client education assets.

Sales Playbooks – Scripts, call flows, and objection handling guides tailored to your services.

Staff Enablement Workshops – Live or virtual trainings on converting consults, packaging services, and maximizing upsells.

✨ Positioning Statement:

This suite combines AI-powered client acquisition + human-led consulting & training, giving aesthetic & wellness practices the exact tools, systems, and coaching they need to increase consults, close more packages, and grow recurring revenue — all under one roof.

🧩 Real-World Examples of AI & Consulting in Aesthetic / Wellness Practices
1. Core Consulting & Growth Strategy

Business Audit & Growth Roadmap → Example: Reviewing monthly Botox/filler consults vs. conversion rate. If they’re booking 30 consults but only closing 12, we redesign the consult flow and add AI follow-up sequences.

Offer Packaging & Pricing → Example: Instead of selling single IV drips for $150, bundle them into a “Glow Reset Package” (4 IVs + skincare kit for $799).

Sales Training → Example: Train front desk staff to shift from “Would you like to book?” → “Most clients who love Botox also choose filler in the same session for best results. Would you like me to schedule both today?”

2. AI-Powered Client Acquisition & Sales Enablement

Acquisity CRM™ → Example: Auto-sends a text + email reminder to a lead who booked a lip filler consult, reducing no-shows.

Hermes – AI SDR → Example: New leads from Facebook ads are instantly texted by “Hermes,” who qualifies them (“Are you most interested in wrinkle reduction, lip enhancement, or skin tightening?”) before handing off to staff.

AI Cold Email Writer → Example: Generate a series of personalized emails for local professionals: “Hi Sarah, as someone in the legal field, I know long work hours can show up on your skin…”

AI Voice & Video Tools → Example: Clinic owner records a 20-second video intro, then AI clones it to send personalized “Welcome Sarah!” videos to each new lead.

Sales Call Analyzer → Example: A recorded HRT consultation is analyzed by AI, showing that the provider spends too much time on medical detail and not enough on patient outcomes. Coaching fixes this.

Cargo AI (Sales Copilot) → Example: Helps the owner see exactly where leads drop off in the funnel (lots of clicks on laser ads, but consult bookings are low).

3. AI Growth & Revenue Tools

AI Growth Plan Creator → Example: Generates a 6-month action plan for a medspa wanting to grow from $40K → $60K monthly revenue, including ad budget, offers, and consult targets.

AI Offer Creator → Example: Builds a “Fall Glow Campaign” landing page: Botox + Hydrafacial bundle with clear pricing, urgency timers, and upsell prompts.

AI Pricing Calculator → Example: Clinic runs numbers and sees they can raise filler package pricing from $1,200 → $1,350 without affecting demand, adding $36K annually.

Continuity & Membership Models → Example: Create a “VIP Glow Club” ($199/mo includes 1 facial, member Botox pricing, and birthday perks).

Packaging & Bundling → Example: Combine weight loss program + peptide therapy + skin tightening into a “Total Body Renewal” package.

4. Marketing & Creative Enablement

Arcads / MakeUGC / ReelFarm → Example: AI generates TikTok/Reel ads that look like clients sharing before/after experiences.

OpusClip & Descript → Example: Take a 45-min webinar on menopause wellness and turn it into 8 short clips for Instagram & TikTok.

Captions.ai & Bluecast → Example: Clinic records a PRP treatment video, AI adds subtitles + LinkedIn caption optimized for local reach.

EverArt / Playground AI / Recraft AI → Example: Generate AI visuals of “before/after skin glow” for ads without needing real client photography.

Beatoven.ai → Example: Adds calming, royalty-free background music to HRT educational videos.

5. Client Retention & Experience

Blaise AI → Example: Clients who just had laser resurfacing get automatic post-care instructions & reminders via chat.

Intercom AI & Proxy AI → Example: A client messages “Is it safe to work out after Botox?” → AI instantly replies: “Avoid exercise for 24 hours to minimize bruising.”

Fireflies.ai / Fathom → Example: AI transcribes provider-patient wellness consults, making it easier to document treatment plans.

NotebookLM & Supermemory → Example: Clinic stores all FAQs, protocols, and scripts. Staff can instantly ask, “What’s our peptide therapy dosage protocol?”

Custom Membership Portals → Example: Patients log in to see upcoming appointments, member perks, and personalized skincare tips.

6. Advanced Enablement & Add-Ons

Consulting Sprints → Example: A 30-day sprint to launch a new Hormone Therapy Program complete with offers, ads, and scripts.

Done-for-You Creative → Example: AI generates before/after mockups for a “Holiday Glow” filler campaign.

Sales Playbooks → Example: Provide front desk with a binder: “If client calls asking for price → Here’s the script that shifts focus to value & packages.”

Staff Enablement Workshops → Example: Monthly Zoom training for staff on “Upselling without feeling pushy.”

✨ Each example shows how the tech + consulting directly improves lead generation, consult conversions, retention, or recurring revenue — the four main levers of medspa growth.
